it.homeTitle: Soluzioni per la mobilità sostenibile nelle aree industriali
it.homeSubtitle: MoMa.BIZ (Mobility Management for Business and Industrial Zones) mette in contatto imprese, lavoratori e territori con un approccio pratico e replicabile.
it.historyText: MoMa.BIZ è un progetto europeo svoltosi tra il 2011 e il 2014 per ridurre l'impatto della mobilità privata nelle Business and Industrial Zones. Sei partner hanno collaborato per sviluppare strumenti, formazione e un percorso partecipato in diverse aree industriali.
it.areasTitle: La storia: Le aree industriali coinvolte dal 2011 al 2014
it.areasCardText: Coinvolti in questo progetto europeo per mobilità sostenibile nelle aree industriali.
it.boxedText: Soluzioni pronte per la mobilità sostenibile nelle aziende e nelle aree industriali. Inserisci la tua email per ricevere il kit di materiali via mail.
it.boxedNote: Ti invieremo un link per scaricare i materiali e iniziare a usare le Boxed Solutions nella tua area industriale.
it.boxedFormCta: Lascia la tua mail per ricevere gratuitamente le boxed solutions
it.contactPhoneValidation: Il numero di telefono e obbligatorio.
it.mobilityText: La Mobility Label è uno strumento che misura la sostenibilità degli spostamenti in una zona industriale. Funziona come un'etichetta energetica e mostra dove sono possibili miglioramenti.
it.mobilityExplain: Scopri il metodo della Mobility Label e accedi alla demo online per valutare rapidamente la mobilità della tua area.
it.videoText: Guarda i video dal canale YouTube ufficiale di MoMa.BIZ con interviste, presentazioni ed esempi dalle aree industriali europee.
it.drtText: Materiali e presentazioni del Seminario Internazionale sul Trasporto Flessibile, tenutosi ad Asti il 24 gennaio 2011.
it.boxedIntro: Kit pronti all'uso per implementare la mobilità sostenibile nella tua area industriale.
it.partnerCtaTitle: Cerchi partner per progetti europei sulla mobilità sostenibile?
it.partnerCtaText: Unisciti alla rete di organizzazioni che lavorano insieme per soluzioni di mobilità innovative in Europa.
it.msqCtaTitle: Vuoi migliorare l'accessibilità della tua area industriale?
it.msqCtaText: Sperimenta il metodo MoMa.BIZ con il supporto di MobilitySquare per una mobilità più sostenibile e accessibile.

en.homeTitle: Sustainable mobility solutions for industrial areas
en.homeSubtitle: MoMa.BIZ (Mobility Management for Business and Industrial Zones) connects companies, workers and territorial actors with practical mobility tools.
en.historyText: MoMa.BIZ is a European initiative that took place from 2011 to 2014 to reduce the impact of private mobility in Business and Industrial Zones. Six partners collaborated to develop tools, training and a participatory pathway across multiple countries.
en.areasTitle: The story: Industrial areas involved from 2011 to 2014
en.areasCardText: Involved in this European project for sustainable mobility in industrial areas.
en.boxedText: Ready-made solutions for sustainable mobility in business parks and industrial zones. Enter your email to request the download kit.
en.boxedNote: We will send you a link to download the materials and start using Boxed Solutions in your area.
en.boxedFormCta: Leave your email to receive the boxed solutions for free
en.emailValidation: Please enter a valid email address.
en.mobilityText: The Mobility Label is a tool that measures the sustainability of travel in an industrial zone. It works like an energy label and shows where improvements are needed.
en.mobilityExplain: Learn about the Mobility Label method and access the online demo to assess your area quickly.
en.videoText: Watch videos from the official MoMa.BIZ YouTube channel featuring interviews, presentations and examples from European industrial areas.
en.drtText: Presentations and materials from the International Seminar on Flexible Transport, held in Asti on 24 January 2011.
en.boxedIntro: Ready-to-use kits for implementing sustainable mobility in your industrial area.
en.partnerCtaTitle: Looking for partners for European sustainable mobility projects?
en.partnerCtaText: Join the network of organisations working together on innovative mobility solutions across Europe.
en.msqCtaTitle: Want to improve accessibility in your industrial area?
en.msqCtaText: Experience the MoMa.BIZ method with MobilitySquare's support for more sustainable and accessible mobility.

es.homeTitle: Soluciones de movilidad sostenible para zonas industriales
es.homeSubtitle: MoMa.BIZ (Mobility Management for Business and Industrial Zones) conecta empresas, trabajadores y territorios con herramientas prácticas de movilidad.
es.historyText: MoMa.BIZ es una iniciativa europea que se llevó a cabo entre 2011 y 2014  para reducir el impacto de la movilidad privada en las Business and Industrial Zones. Seis socios colaboraron para desarrollar herramientas, formación y un camino participativo en varios países.
es.areasTitle: La historia: Zonas industriales implicadas del 2011 al 2014
es.areasCardText: Participan en este proyecto europeo de movilidad sostenible en zonas industriales.
es.boxedText: Soluciones listas para la movilidad sostenible en parques empresariales y zonas industriales. Introduce tu correo electrónico para solicitar el kit de descarga.
es.boxedNote: Te enviaremos un enlace para descargar los materiales y comenzar a usar las Boxed Solutions.
es.boxedFormCta: Deja tu correo para recibir gratuitamente las boxed solutions
es.emailValidation: Por favor, introduce una dirección de correo válida.
es.mobilityText: La Mobility Label es una herramienta que mide la sostenibilidad de los desplazamientos en una zona industrial. Funciona como una etiqueta energética y muestra dónde mejorar.
es.mobilityExplain: Descubre el método Mobility Label y accede a la demo en línea para evaluar tu zona rápidamente.
es.videoText: Vea los vídeos del canal oficial de YouTube de MoMa.BIZ con entrevistas, presentaciones y ejemplos de zonas industriales europeas.
es.drtText: Presentaciones y materiales del Seminario Internacional sobre Transporte Flexible, celebrado en Asti el 24 de enero de 2011.
es.boxedIntro: Kits listos para implementar la movilidad sostenible en tu zona industrial.
es.partnerCtaTitle: ¿Buscas socios para proyectos europeos de movilidad sostenible?
es.partnerCtaText: Únete a la red de organizaciones que trabajan juntas en soluciones de movilidad innovadoras en Europa.
es.msqCtaTitle: ¿Quieres mejorar la accesibilidad en tu zona industrial?
es.msqCtaText: Experimenta el método MoMa.BIZ con el apoyo de MobilitySquare para una movilidad más sostenible y accesible.

et.homeSubtitle: MoMa.BIZ (Mobility Management for Business and Industrial Zones) ühendab ettevõtted, töötajad ja piirkonnad praktiliste liikumisvahenditega.
et.historyText: MoMa.BIZ on Euroopa algatus, mis toimus 2011–2014, eesmärgiga vähendada eraliikluse mõju äripiirkondades ja tööstuspiirkondades. Kuus partnerit töötasid koos tööriistade, koolituse ja kaasava lähenemise väljatöötamiseks.
et.areasCardText: Selles Euroopa projektis osalevad tööstuspiirkondade jätkusuutliku liikuvuse partnerid.
et.boxedText: Valmis lahendused säästlikuks liikumiseks äriparkides ja tööstuspiirkondades. Sisesta oma e-post, et saada allalaadimiskomplekt.
et.boxedNote: Saadame sulle lingi materjalide allalaadimiseks ja Boxed Solutions kasutamise alustamiseks.
et.boxedFormCta: Jata oma e-post, et saada boxed solutions tasuta
et.mobilityText: Mobility Label mõõdab tööstuspiirkonna liikumise jätkusuutlikkust. See toimib nagu energiasilt ja näitab parenduskohti.
et.mobilityExplain: Tutvu Mobility Label meetodiga ja kasuta veebikihlme demo, et piirkonda kiiresti hinnata.
et.videoText: Vaadake videoid ametlikust MoMa.BIZ YouTube'i kanalist, mis sisaldab intervjuusid, esitlusi ja näiteid Euroopa tööstuspiirkondadest.
et.drtText: Esitlused ja materjalid rahvusvaheliselt paindliku transpordi seminarilt, mis toimus Astis 24. jaanuaril 2011.
et.boxedIntro: Kasutamisvalmis komplektid jätkusuutliku liikuvuse rakendamiseks tööstuspiirkonnas.
et.partnerCtaTitle: Otsid partnereid Euroopa jätkusuutliku liikuvuse projektideks?
et.partnerCtaText: Liitu organisatsioonide võrgustikuga, kes töötavad koos uuenduslike liikuvuslahenduste nimel Euroopas.
et.msqCtaText: Katsetage MoMa.BIZ meetodit MobilitySquare'i toel jätkusuutlikuma ja ligipääsetavama liikuvuse saavutamiseks.

bg.homeTitle: Устойчиви транспортни решения за индустриални зони
bg.homeSubtitle: MoMa.BIZ  (Mobility Management for Business and Industrial Zones)свързва компании, работници и региони с практични инструменти за мобилност.
bg.historyText: MoMa.BIZ е европейска инициатива, създадена да намали въздействието на личния транспорт в Business and Industrial Zones. Шест партньора разработиха инструменти, обучения и участнически процес в няколко държави.
bg.areasTitle: История: Включени индустриални зони от 2011 до 2014
bg.areasCardText: Участници в този европейски проект за устойчива мобилност в индустриалните зони.
bg.boxedText: Готови решения за устойчива мобилност в бизнес паркове и индустриални зони. Въведете своя имейл, за да получите комплекта за изтегляне.
bg.boxedNote: Ще ви изпратим линк за изтегляне на материалите и да започнете с Boxed Solutions.
bg.boxedFormCta: Оставете своя имейл, за да получите безплатно boxed solutions
bg.mobilityText: Mobility Label е инструмент, който измерва устойчивостта на пътуванията в индустриална зона. Той работи като енергийна етикета и показва къде са нужни подобрения.
bg.mobilityExplain: Научете за метода Mobility Label и отворете онлайн демото, за да оцените бързо вашата зона.
bg.videoText: Гледайте видеата от официалния YouTube канал на MoMa.BIZ с интервюта, презентации и примери от европейски индустриални зони.
bg.drtText: Презентации и материали от Международния семинар за гъвкав транспорт, проведен в Асти на 24 януари 2011 г.
bg.boxedIntro: Готови комплекти за прилагане на устойчива мобилност в индустриалната ви зона.
bg.partnerCtaTitle: Търсите партньори за европейски проекти за устойчива мобилност?
bg.partnerCtaText: Присъединете се към мрежата от организации, работещи заедно за иновативни решения за мобилност в Европа.
bg.msqCtaTitle: Искате да подобрите достъпността на индустриалната си зона?
bg.msqCtaText: Изпробвайте метода MoMa.BIZ с подкрепата на MobilitySquare за по-устойчива и достъпна мобилност.
